**<sub><sub>![P1 Badge](https://img.shields.io/badge/P1-orange?style=flat)</sub></sub>  Remove the unsupported self-service deletion promise**

When a meeting owner tries to exercise this advertised control, the portal and meetings router provide no meeting-history deletion operation, and the storage layer has no corresponding DynamoDB MeetingHistory or S3 object deletion path; the repository-wide delete search only finds active-meeting, share, index, and Notion-export cleanup. The same unsupported promise also appears in the short version and Terms, so either implement complete deletion or remove these claims before publishing the policy.

Useful? React with 👍 / 👎.

**<sub><sub>![P1 Badge](https://img.shields.io/badge/P1-orange?style=flat)</sub></sub>  Wire analytics variables into both frontend deploys**

In the checked production and sandbox frontend jobs, `yarn build:web` receives only `VITE_API_BASE_URL`; neither workflow exposes `VITE_POSTHOG_KEY` or `VITE_POSTHOG_HOST`, and Terraform only provisions the API variable. GitHub environment variables are not automatically exported to the build process, so deployed HTML retains the placeholders, `resolveKey()` returns empty, and all newly added analytics silently remain disabled.

**<sub><sub>![P1 Badge](https://img.shields.io/badge/P1-orange?style=flat)</sub></sub>  Disclose PostHog in the privacy policy**

When `VITE_POSTHOG_KEY` is configured, `initAnalytics()` runs for the entire SPA and sends page-view and CTA event data to PostHog, but this exhaustive third-party processor table omits PostHog and the policy otherwise gives users no analytics disclosure. Add the provider and accurately describe the data, purpose, retention, and applicable user choices before enabling the key.

**<sub><sub>![P1 Badge](https://img.shields.io/badge/P1-orange?style=flat)</sub></sub>  Disable upgrades when the selected interval is unavailable**

If Stripe returns an annual Basic price but the annual Pro price is missing or inactive, `hasAnnualPlans` still enables Annual for the whole table, while `resolvePaidPlan` substitutes the monthly Pro plan and displays that amount as `/ yr`. This new Pro CTA then navigates with `interval: "year"`, but checkout performs an exact tier-and-interval lookup and returns `Pricing unavailable for selected plan`; enable and label each CTA from the exact selected plan rather than the monthly fallback.

**<sub><sub>![P1 Badge](https://img.shields.io/badge/P1-orange?style=flat)</sub></sub>  Complete the governing-law section before publishing**

The footer now links users directly to these Terms, but the contract's governing-law section contains only an internal TODO and therefore never states the promised jurisdiction or venue. Replace the placeholder with reviewed terms, or withhold the public Terms link until the legal text is complete.

**<sub><sub>![P1 Badge](https://img.shields.io/badge/P1-orange?style=flat)</sub></sub>  Remove the paid-tier gate from the free TTS allowance**

Setting the free monthly limit to 50 does not make any TTS messages usable on a free server: `/say` rejects the request when `limits.liveVoiceEnabled` is false, `/tts` returns the same Basic-plan upgrade prompt, and `meetingVoiceSettingsService` masks both chat-TTS flags behind that entitlement. Because the free tier always sets `liveVoiceEnabled: false`, users advertised 50 messages per month can never reach the quota logic; grant chat TTS independently of live voice or revert the advertised allowance.

Useful? React with 👍 / 👎.

**<sub><sub>![P1 Badge](https://img.shields.io/badge/P1-orange?style=flat)</sub></sub>  Redact bearer share URLs from pageview capture**

When `VITE_POSTHOG_KEY` is configured, history-based pageviews send the current URL to PostHog, including routes such as `/share/meeting/$serverId/$shareId`. The repository explicitly treats these share links as bearer credentials (`useSharePageMeta.ts:33`), so opening a public meeting stores a reusable access credential with a third party despite the page's no-referrer protection. Capture sanitized route templates manually, or exclude/redact share routes before enabling automatic pageviews.

Useful? React with 👍 / 👎.

**<sub><sub>![P1 Badge](https://img.shields.io/badge/P1-orange?style=flat)</sub></sub>  Disable session replay before initializing PostHog**

[AGENT] When session recording is enabled for the configured PostHog project, this site-wide initialization permits the SDK to record authenticated portal pages containing meeting transcripts, notes, usernames, and other user content. `sanitize_properties` only transforms analytics event properties and does not sanitize replay snapshots, while the new privacy disclosure describes only page views and clicks. Explicitly set `disable_session_recording: true` for this analytics-only integration before deploying the key.

Useful? React with 👍 / 👎.

**<sub><sub>![P2 Badge](https://img.shields.io/badge/P2-yellow?style=flat)</sub></sub>  Refresh the stale home visual baseline**

[AGENT] The updated control copy says “Archive any meeting,” but the committed `home-full-chromium-win32.png` baseline still visibly renders “Delete any meeting.” Because `visual.spec.ts` allows up to 2,000 changed pixels, this small stale region can pass while leaving the baseline inconsistent with the intended UI and obscuring later regressions. Regenerate and visually review the home snapshots after the final copy change.

**<sub><sub>![P1 Badge](https://img.shields.io/badge/P1-orange?style=flat)</sub></sub>  Disable default autocapture on authenticated pages**

[AGENT] When `VITE_POSTHOG_KEY` is configured and a user clicks rendered meeting notes or transcript text in the portal, posthog-js enables autocapture by default and can include DOM text and attributes in its `$autocapture` element data. The integration already sends the intended CTA events manually, but this configuration neither sets `autocapture: false` nor masks user-content elements, and the shallow `sanitize_properties` callback does not remove strings nested inside autocapture's element metadata. Disable autocapture globally, or explicitly mask all user-content DOM and sanitize nested metadata, to avoid sending meeting content to PostHog.

Useful? React with 👍 / 👎.

**<sub><sub>![P2 Badge](https://img.shields.io/badge/P2-yellow?style=flat)</sub></sub>  Derive the advertised annual saving from plan prices**

[AGENT] When either independently configured Stripe annual price is not exactly ten times its monthly price, this shared constant falsely advertises “2 months free” on the homepage, billing page, and upgrade flow. `getPaidPlans()` returns the actual `unitAmount` for each tier and interval without enforcing that ratio, so compute a tier-specific saving from those returned plans or use wording that remains accurate for arbitrary configured prices.

Useful? React with 👍 / 👎.

**<sub><sub>![P2 Badge](https://img.shields.io/badge/P2-yellow?style=flat)</sub></sub>  Scope canonical metadata to the current public route**

[AGENT] Because CloudFront serves `/index.html` for every SPA route (`_infra/main.tf:1105-1116`), direct requests for `/join`, `/promo/...`, and other public pages all receive this homepage canonical URL. Search engines will therefore treat those pages as duplicates of the homepage instead of indexing their actual URLs; emit this tag only for `/` or update it per route.

Useful? React with 👍 / 👎.

**<sub><sub>![P2 Badge](https://img.shields.io/badge/P2-yellow?style=flat)</sub></sub>  Give each upgrade button a distinct accessible name**

[AGENT] Screen-reader users navigating by buttons encounter two controls both announced only as “Upgrade,” so they cannot determine which one selects Basic and which selects Pro without reconstructing the surrounding table. Preserve the previous plan-specific names, such as “Upgrade to Basic” and “Upgrade to Pro,” or add equivalent accessible labels.

Useful? React with 👍 / 👎.

**<sub><sub>![P2 Badge](https://img.shields.io/badge/P2-yellow?style=flat)</sub></sub>  Add a mobile assertion for pricing-table scrolling**

[AGENT] At viewports narrower than `PRICING_TABLE_MIN_WIDTH`, the Basic and Pro columns and their actions are reachable only through this horizontal scroll container, but the home E2E test checks only the hero and CTA while the visual suite uses a 1280px viewport. Add a mobile Playwright assertion proving `scrollWidth > clientWidth` and that `scrollLeft` changes so overflow or clipping regressions cannot silently hide paid plans.

**<sub><sub>![P2 Badge](https://img.shields.io/badge/P2-yellow?style=flat)</sub></sub>  Offset the in-page target below the fixed header**

[AGENT] When a visitor activates “See what it sends back,” the browser aligns this target with the top of the viewport, but `MarketingLayout` uses a fixed 72px `AppShell.Header` and neither this target nor the document defines a scroll offset. The section heading is consequently positioned underneath the header; add an appropriate `scroll-margin-top` or document scroll padding so the destination remains visible.

Useful? React with 👍 / 👎.

**<sub><sub>![P1 Badge](https://img.shields.io/badge/P1-orange?style=flat)</sub></sub>  Stop Terraform from overriding the onboarding default**

[AGENT] In Terraform-backed deployments that do not explicitly override this setting, `_infra/main.tf` still defaults `ENABLE_ONBOARDING` to `"false"` and always injects that value into ECS, so this expression remains false in production and sandbox. Consequently, `guildCreate` returns before sending the new `/join` DM and the onboarding commands remain disabled; because the Discord invite itself has no redirect URL, the intended first-run path is still absent. Change the Terraform default and example alongside this application default.

Useful? React with 👍 / 👎.

**<sub><sub>![P1 Badge](https://img.shields.io/badge/P1-orange?style=flat)</sub></sub>  Disclose the Discord OAuth credentials stored in sessions**

[AGENT] When a user signs in to the portal, the OAuth callback requests the `email` scope and `buildDiscordAuthProfile` adds the Discord access token, refresh token, and expiry to the profile; `passport.serializeUser` then saves that entire object through `DynamoSessionStore`. This row only discloses the account ID, username, avatar, and server list, omitting both the email address and the reusable OAuth credentials actually stored in DynamoDB. Add those data categories, their purpose, and their retention to the policy.

Useful? React with 👍 / 👎.

**<sub><sub>![P1 Badge](https://img.shields.io/badge/P1-orange?style=flat)</sub></sub>  Disclose audio sent to Langfuse**

[AGENT] When Langfuse tracing is configured, each transcription schedules its input file through `buildLangfuseTranscriptionAudioAttachment`, which compresses the recording and attaches up to 8 MB of audio bytes to the Langfuse observation in `transcriptionService.ts`. The provider disclosure says Langfuse traces can contain only transcript and notes content, so users are not told that their voice audio is also transferred to this third party. Either disclose this audio processing accurately or stop attaching the media.

Useful? React with 👍 / 👎.

**<sub><sub>![P2 Badge](https://img.shields.io/badge/P2-yellow?style=flat)</sub></sub>  Derive paid TTS quotas from the configured limits**

[AGENT] When an operator changes `CHAT_TTS_MONTHLY_BASIC_MESSAGE_LIMIT` from 1,000 or configures a finite `CHAT_TTS_MONTHLY_PRO_MESSAGE_LIMIT`, `subscriptionService` enforces those overridden values but this public pricing table continues to promise 1,000 and Unlimited. Because these are supported environment settings documented in `.env.example`, an operational quota adjustment can make the advertised paid plan materially incorrect; return the effective limits from the pricing API or avoid fixed quota claims here.

Useful? React with 👍 / 👎.

**<sub><sub>![P1 Badge](https://img.shields.io/badge/P1-orange?style=flat)</sub></sub>  Match the retention policy to implemented storage**

For Free and Basic meetings, this tells users that older meeting data is removed according to plan-specific retention, but the `MeetingHistoryTable` has no DynamoDB TTL, the transcripts S3 bucket has no expiration lifecycle, and the meeting list/detail paths apply no tier-based retention cutoff. Those plans therefore retain and expose audio, transcripts, and notes indefinitely just like Pro, which makes the newly published privacy statement inaccurate; either implement the promised expiration across DynamoDB, S3, and indexes or remove the claim.

**<sub><sub>![P2 Badge](https://img.shields.io/badge/P2-yellow?style=flat)</sub></sub>  Enforce tier limits in the portal Ask flow**

[AGENT] When a Pro member asks a question through the web portal, `src/trpc/routers/ask.ts:118-127` calls `askWithConversation` without a tier limit, and `answerQuestionService` consequently defaults every portal request to `config.ask.maxMeetings` (25) at `src/services/askService.ts:240`; only the Discord slash-command path resolves `limits.maxAskMeetings`. The newly advertised “Last 100 meetings” therefore remains unavailable in the portal, so pass the guild's tier limit into this flow or qualify the pricing claim.

Useful? React with 👍 / 👎.

**<sub><sub>![P1 Badge](https://img.shields.io/badge/P1-orange?style=flat)</sub></sub>  Disclose Ask conversation processing**

[AGENT] When a portal user uses Ask, `askConversationService.ts:319-325` persists the user's question and later the generated reply in `AskConversationTable`, while `askService.ts:313-329` sends the question, conversation history, and selected meeting context to OpenAI. The new policy lists neither Ask conversations among stored data nor answering questions among OpenAI's purposes, so users of this advertised feature are not told that their questions and answers are retained and processed by a third party; add both disclosures.

Useful? React with 👍 / 👎.

**<sub><sub>![P1 Badge](https://img.shields.io/badge/P1-orange?style=flat)</sub></sub>  Disclose stored meeting-channel chat**

[AGENT] When a recorded meeting contains channel messages, `endMeeting.ts:279-285` writes the complete chat log, including attachment URLs, and `uploadService.ts:172-192` stores both text and JSON copies in S3; `notesPromptService.ts:191-217` also incorporates that chat into the OpenAI notes prompt. Although the policy says chat is captured, this storage table omits it and the OpenAI disclosure names only audio and transcript content, so members are not told that their channel messages and attachment links are retained and transferred for note generation; disclose both uses explicitly.

Useful? React with 👍 / 👎.
